instructions: Tools for US weather data from the National Weather Service (weather.gov). Use get_active_alerts for current alerts/watches/warnings/advisories (including severe weather) covering a point or area. Use get_forecast/get_hourly_forecast for future conditions at a location. Use get_current_conditions for the latest observed conditions near a point. Use get_alert_details to fetch full text of a specific alert by its ID. All location-based tools accept latitude/longitude and internally resolve the NWS grid/zone/station, so you never need to know NWS internal IDs.

secrets.description: Identifies this application to the weather.gov API, as required by their usage policy.

tools.name: get_active_alerts
tools.description: Checks for currently active weather alerts, watches, warnings, and advisories (including severe weather, tornadoes, floods, winter storms, etc). Use this whenever a user asks 'are there any weather alerts/warnings' for a location, state, or the whole country — including questions specifically about 'severe weather'. To restrict to only severe-level alerts, pass severity='Severe'; leave severity unset to get alerts of all severities. Do NOT use for future/forecast conditions (use get_forecast instead). Returns a list of active alerts with headline, severity, urgency, certainty, area description, and effective/expiration times.

args.name: point
args.description: Latitude,longitude of the location to check, e.g. '36.1699,-115.1398'. Omit if using area instead.

args.name: area
args.description: Comma-separated two-letter US state or marine area codes to check instead of a point, e.g. 'NV' or 'NV,CA'.

args.name: severity
args.description: Comma-separated severity levels to filter by: Extreme, Severe, Moderate, Minor, Unknown. Set to 'Severe' when the user asks about 'severe weather'. Omit to include all severities.

args.name: event
args.description: Comma-separated event names to filter by, e.g. 'Tornado Warning,Flood Warning'. Omit to include all event types.

args.name: urgency
args.description: Comma-separated urgency levels to filter by: Immediate, Expected, Future, Past, Unknown. Omit for all.

tools.returns: List of active alert features with properties (headline, severity, urgency, certainty, areaDesc, effective, expires, description, instruction).

tools.name: get_alert_details
tools.description: Fetches the full details of one specific weather alert given its alert ID (as returned in the 'id' field of get_active_alerts results). Use this only when you already have a specific alert ID and need its complete text; do not use it to search for alerts.

args.name: alert_id
args.description: The full alert identifier/ID string, e.g. 'urn:oid:2.49.0.1.840.0...'.

tools.returns: Full alert object including area description, affected zones, sent/effective/onset/expires times, and instructions.

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description: Gets the multi-day textual weather forecast (e.g. 'Tonight', 'Monday', 'Monday Night') for a US latitude/longitude point. Use this for questions about upcoming weather over the next several days. For hour-by-hour detail, use get_hourly_forecast instead. For active alerts/warnings, use get_active_alerts instead.

args.name: latitude
args.description: Latitude of the location, decimal degrees.

args.name: longitude
args.description: Longitude of the location, decimal degrees.

args.name: units
args.description: Unit system for the forecast text: 'us' for US customary or 'si' for metric. Defaults to 'us'.

tools.returns: List of forecast periods, each with name, temperature, wind, and a short forecast description.

tools.name: get_hourly_forecast
tools.description: Gets the hour-by-hour weather forecast for a US latitude/longitude point, covering the next several days in 1-hour increments. Use this when the user wants detailed near-term timing (e.g. 'will it rain this afternoon'). For multi-day summaries use get_forecast instead.

args.name: latitude
args.description: Latitude of the location, decimal degrees.

args.name: longitude
args.description: Longitude of the location, decimal degrees.

args.name: units
args.description: Unit system for the forecast text: 'us' for US customary or 'si' for metric. Defaults to 'us'.

tools.returns: List of hourly forecast periods, each with start time, temperature, wind, and short forecast description.

tools.name: get_current_conditions
tools.description: Gets the most recent observed weather conditions (temperature, wind, humidity, etc) from the nearest weather station to a US latitude/longitude point. Use this for 'what is the weather right now' questions. Do NOT use this for future forecasts (use get_forecast) or for alerts (use get_active_alerts).

args.name: latitude
args.description: Latitude of the location, decimal degrees.

args.name: longitude
args.description: Longitude of the location, decimal degrees.

tools.returns: Latest observation for the nearest station: temperature, wind speed/direction, humidity, visibility, textDescription, and timestamp.
